study: Arm EARLIER on support instead of squares: on seated desk names, arm on the first touch/reclaim of a known point-in-time support order block with room to resistance >= 0.40%, no square/exhaustion print required; compare with the desk's square-arm entries on the same name-days.
registered_at: 2026-10-05 ~19:10 ET, before any support-arm outcome was computed
origin: Operator (Jonathan) approved 2026-10-05: arm earlier using support instead of squares. Siblings the same day (order_block_gate, sr_range_trade, sr_gap_wr60_arm, sr_exit_resist, sr_size_by_room, sr_breakout_confirm) all FAIL.
script: tools/studies/sr_support_arm.py; blocks from tools/order_blocks.py (point-in-time, charted last 3 per side, swing 10, wicks, 1-min)
sample: seated desk names = name-days with at least one E square arm in ai_reports/indicator_levels/rows.json ($10+, 554 name-days, 16 days 2026-09-11..10-02), 1-min premarket+RTH SIP bars from ext.pkl (day + prior day). 2026-10-05 is NOT in the cached bars and is EXCLUDED (no new data fetch). Same sessions as the order-block studies.
halves: chronological over the 16 sample days: A = first 8 days (09-11..09-22), B = last 8 days (09-23..10-02)
support_arm: at a 1-min close i, decision window 09:40-15:30 ET: a charted support block S known at that close (unbroken bullish OB or bearish breaker, known_ts <= close) with low[i] <= S.top AND close[i] >= S.btm (touched or reclaimed the zone and closed at or above its bottom). Only the FIRST such bar per block per name-day counts (later touches of the same block are ignored). Not inside a charted resistance block at close[i]. Room = nearest charted resistance bottom above close[i] / close[i] - 1 >= 0.40% (primary); no resistance above -> no arm. One support arm per name per 15 min. NO square / exhaustion print required. %R NOT required in the primary.
square_arm: the desk's square arms on the same name-days = E rows (signal_timing.events_for with live config, one per name per 15 min, 09:40-15:30), decision time t.
outcome: both arms identical: buy at the open of the bar after the decision close; gross = close of the bar 15 min after entry (15:55 cap) / entry - 1; net = gross - 0.20% ($10+ tier). Recomputed for both arms from the same bars by the same function.
primary_statistic: on matched name-days (both >= 1 support arm and >= 1 square arm): mean support gross - mean square gross (arm level), t from a day-clustered (CR1) regression of gross on a support dummy.
measured_round_trip_spread: mean(gross - net) of support entries in the half under the locked 0.20% model (= 20 bp).
pass: in BOTH chronological halves: (support gross - square gross) > measured RT spread of that half, with >= 50 support arms per half. Report net after costs, n per half, t. Fewer than 50 -> UNDERPOWERED. Any PASS = PENDING SKEPTIC REVIEW (not a live arm; SIP != IEX; needs held-out IEX confirmation; config untouched incl. ai_watch_ob_resist_skip).
minutes_earlier: on matched name-days: (first square decision time - first support decision time) in minutes; report median, mean and share where support fires first. Also, for each square arm, minutes since the latest earlier support arm on the same name-day (if any).
information_only: same-hour like-for-like control: per support arm one random minute (seed 37) in the same name-day and ET hour (any minute), same outcome; lift vs support
with %R required: fast %R (21, EMA 7) <= -50 at the arm bar
unmatched: all support arms vs all square arms
prior: low. 10/02 near-support cells least-bad but negative; sr_range_trade and sr_gap_wr60_arm FAIL; squares match random minutes in prior studies, so 'earlier' only helps if support touches carry location value the squares lack.
caveats: 15-min fixed hold, not the desk's trail
SIP bars; live desk uses IEX
